markup:
The best thing to buy is a **DC-to-DC alternator charger designed for portable power stations**.

It connects to your car's 12V electrical system and charges your power station much faster than a cigarette-lighter outlet while you're driving.

## How fast can you charge?

| Charging method | Typical power | Time to add 1 kWh |
|---|---:|---:|
| Cigarette lighter | 100–120W | 9–12 hours |
| 500W alternator charger | 500W | ~2–2.5 hours |
| 800W alternator charger | 800W | ~1.3–1.6 hours |
| 1,000W alternator charger | 1,000W | ~1–1.3 hours |

These are approximate charging times, accounting for some losses. Actual speed depends on your power station, vehicle alternator, and battery charge level.

**For most people, a 500–800W alternator charger is the sweet spot.** It provides a substantial speed improvement without requiring an especially high-output vehicle charging system.

## Chargers worth buying
